## Stage 1 - p_on along the stable root, 0 < Lambda_6 < Lambda_max(n) [computed]

Negative Lambda_6 [identity]: on the AdS minimum s > 1, so p_flux > 1 (not a share). The denominator vanishes at Lambda_6 = -b^2/(a c n^2), so p is undefined there; Lambda_6 <= 0 is excluded. Lambda_6 = Lambda_max(n) is the double-root critical point (no minimum, as in Job Five) and is excluded.
